hero.label: Made for Solum Health
hero.headline: I want to be Solum Health's first SDR hire.
hero.subheadline: JP built something rare: a product born from actually running an 80-provider mental health practice, not from guessing at the problem. Solum's AI is replacing real administrative pain that therapy practices feel every single day, and I want to be the person bringing that story to the practices that need it most.

whyCompany.title: Annie solves a problem JP lived firsthand for four years
whyCompany.body: Most healthcare SaaS founders are outsiders pitching at a market. JP managed 20,000 patients and 80 providers before building Solum, which means the product is grounded in operational truth. That founder-market fit is the kind of thing that makes cold outreach genuinely easy to believe in.

whyCompany.title: Three employees, YC-backed, and four open roles right now
whyCompany.body: Solum is at the exact moment where the first SDR shapes how the sales motion gets built, not just executes a playbook someone else wrote. Getting in at this stage means the work I do now compounds into the foundation of a real go-to-market function. That is the kind of opportunity I am actively looking for.

whyCompany.title: I spent 14 months doing exactly this kind of outbound at Copygen.ai
whyCompany.body: At Copygen I owned cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences, and helped the team land 15 to 20 paying clients. My most recent role at NextAfter deepened my understanding of B2B buying cycles and messaging that actually converts. Selling an AI product to therapy practice owners is a specific motion I know I can build.

quote: JP spent four years drowning in the exact administrative chaos Solum fixes. I want to spend the next chapter of my career making sure every therapy practice owner like him finds out it exists.
